title: Crab Derby, 2007 · before
logline: The day before the twenty-third: a tourist in the shack in February, which is wrong, looking at the 1998 flyer on the wall the way people look at things they want. Gully sees the look. Wood, on the stool, sees Gully see it.

panels.composition: The shack in February. A TOURIST in a good coat looking at the oldest flyer on the wall. GULLY behind the counter. WOOD on the stool.
